aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misgroups changed factors, baselines, and outcomes, causing wrong judgements.
issues: Changed factor wrongly combines line-transfer and bonding-amount tests.
Normal baselines are not paired by adjacent shift, line, and section rows.
Overall judgement marked improved despite mixed NG-rate results.
Measurement outcome is invalid; header/defect columns were treated as measurements.
Evidence includes non-cited header rows and omits needed pair context.
correctionPlan: Split into line-transfer test and bonding-amount test changed factors.
Recalculate each NG-rate delta and mark mixed where applicable.
Remove the measurement outcome unless real measurement rows exist.
Cite purpose, content, section headers, and each paired result row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because pair grouping and header-only evidence are unreliable.
